# shadcn/ui audit

TL;DR: the extension frontend now uses the current shadcn/Radix primitives for
forms, empty states, copy actions, collapsible setup content, and settings
search. The only registry deviations left are deliberate Tailwind v3 and
extension-runtime compatibility patches.

## What changed

Official shadcn components added in this pass:

- `field`
- `label`
- `input-group`
- `collapsible`
- `tooltip`
- `textarea`, pulled in by the `field` and `input-group` registry items

Existing primitives refreshed or verified against the registry:

- `empty`
- `separator`
- `button`
- `input`

App-level shared wrappers now live in
`src/features/common/components/settings-ui.tsx`. They centralize settings
sections, switch rows, status badges, copy buttons, code copy blocks, and setup
step indicators while still composing project-owned shadcn primitives.

## Intentional deviations

| File | Deviation | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src/components/ui/field.tsx` | Uses `has-[[data-state=checked]]:*` and `[&:nth-last-child(2)]:*` instead of the latest registry `has-data-*` and `nth-last-2` shorthands. | Tailwind v3.4 in this project does not emit CSS for those registry shorthands. The replacements compile to equivalent selectors. |
| `src/components/ui/scroll-area.tsx` | Keeps `"use client"`. | Plasmo extension surfaces run client-side, and the local primitive already used the directive safely. |
| `src/components/ui/separator.tsx` | Keeps `"use client"`. | Same client-only extension runtime reason as `scroll-area`. |
| `src/components/ui/input-group.tsx` | Keeps `"use client"`. | `InputGroupAddon` handles click-to-focus behavior, so the directive is explicit and correct for this runtime. |

The final shadcn dry run reported five overwrites: `scroll-area`,
`separator`, `input-group`, and `field` for the deviations above, plus `select`
in the aggregate dry-run output. A targeted `select` diff reported no actual
file changes.

## Verification

Commands run after all UI changes:

```bash
bun run typecheck
bun run test
bun run verify:layout
BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/bun-shadcn-quality-dryrun-cache \
  bunx --bun shadcn@latest add alert badge button card dialog empty input \
  scroll-area select separator sheet skeleton sonner switch tabs toggle-group \
  toggle field label input-group collapsible tooltip --dry-run
```

Results:

- `bun run typecheck` passed.
- `bun run test` passed, 85 tests, 0 failures.
- `bun run verify:layout` passed for sidepanel and options mobile/desktop
  checks, with no horizontal overflow and no console errors.
- shadcn dry-run passed with only the intentional deviations listed above.
